usage.callShape: POST https://x402trustlayer.xyz/api/agent-escrow with JSON body {action, payerAgentId, payeeAgentId, amountUsdc, releaseCondition} (x402 payment $0.12 USDC on Base/Polygon/Solana)
usage.outputShape: Expected (per outputSchema, NOT observed): body.ok, body.allowed, body.summary, body.confidence, body.checks_passed[]. Actual response was an error: body.error, body.reason.
quirks: Endpoint's own x402 facilitator returned facilitator_error_500: 'Timed out while waiting for transaction' - settlement could not complete.
Response was HTTP 402 with paid:false / costUsd:0; the submitted tx hash never landed on-chain (receipt = null), so no USDC was actually lost on the failed attempt.
Required body fields (all): action, payerAgentId, payeeAgentId, amountUsdc, releaseCondition. None of these need a real-world recipient - they are agent IDs + an escrow condition string.
Accepts payment on eip155:8453 (Base), eip155:137 (Polygon), and Solana mainnet, all $0.12 USDC.
usage.guide: This agent-to-agent escrow trust-layer endpoint is currently BROKEN: the provider's own x402 facilitator times out during settlement (facilitator_error_500), returning HTTP 402 without completing payment. Do not rely on it. If retested and working, POST to https://x402trustlayer.xyz/api/agent-escrow with JSON {action, payerAgentId, payeeAgentId, amountUsdc, releaseCondition} and pay $0.12 USDC via x402; read the trust evaluation from body.allowed / body.summary / body.confidence / body.checks_passed[]. Because settlement failed on the only attempt, no charge occurred (tx never confirmed on-chain).
